content.what_it_is: MATLAB function Plot_1Df (L1) in the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence Spectrum_Generator_for_WKDATA2D toolset: plots the 1D frequency spectrum in m2/Hz (comment L3) from spectrum-generator arrays. Algorithm: first loop over i=1:mfreq (L5-12) counts consecutive duplicate frequencies (freq(i)==freq(i-1), L6) into reps_condensed (L7,L10) with running index k (L4,L9); second loop (L15-24) condenses the spectrum by summing Spectrum_Energy(i)*pi into Syy1d_f(k) for duplicate frequencies (L17) or starting a new bin (L20) while recording freq_condensed(k)=freq(i) (L21) and freq_index(k)=i (L22); computes significant wave height Hmo_Syy1d_f = 4*sqrt(sum(Syy1d_f.*freq_resolution)) (L26) rounded to 2 decimals (L27); scatters the condensed spectrum back onto the full freq_no_coh axis via Syy1d_f_whole (L29-30). Then draws two vertical-orientation plots with energy on x (reversed, L34/L59) and frequency on y: figure(11) (L32) plots Syy1d_f_whole vs freq_no_coh (L33) with ylim [0.04 0.25] (L36), xlabel E (m^2/Hz) (L40), grid (L44-45), pbaspect [1 2 1] (L49), fontsize 18 (L50), saved as '1Df_<Coherent_Percentage>p_vertical.png' (L52), then close (L54); figure(1111) (L56) plots a 31-point moving mean Syy1d_f_whole_ma (L57-58) with ylim [0.04 0.25] (L61), xlim [0 0.45] (L62), same labels/grid/aspect (L65,L69-70,L74-75), saved as '1Df_<Coherent_Percentage>p_vertical_ma.png' (L77). ylabel, title (with Hmo), and xticks calls are commented out (L37,L39,L42,L47,L64,L67,L72).
entities: local k (bin counter) — L4, reset L14
local array reps_condensed — first assigned L7/L10
local array Syy1d_f — first assigned L17/L20

equations.ref: significant wave height from spectral moment
scatter condensed spectrum onto full frequency axis

unresolved: reps_condensed is built in the first loop (L5-12) but never used elsewhere in this file — its purpose relative to the second loop (L15-24), which recomputes the same duplicate-detection, is unstated
freq_condensed (L21) is assigned but never used later in this file
Hmo_Syy1d_f (L26-27) is only referenced in commented-out title lines (L42, L67), so the computed value is unused in active code
the factor pi applied to Spectrum_Energy (L17, L20) implies a directional/angular integration convention defined by the calling spectrum generator, not stated in this file
the relation between the condensed freq grid and the full freq_no_coh axis (why direct indexing Syy1d_f_whole(freq_index) at L30 is valid) depends on how the caller constructs freq and freq_no_coh
